extracted.intended_audience: researchers and prospective authors in functional analysis / mathematics considering submission to this journal
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and descriptive metadata for authors and readers about the journal Functional Analysis and Its Applications, including scope, article types, peer-review and language expectations, and journal-level metrics and indexing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal scope / topical fit
rubrics_metrics.description: Functional Analysis and Its Applications is a journal devoted to the studies of vector spaces endowed with limit-related structures and linear functions defined on these spaces. Encompasses the field of functional analysis, including representation theory, theory of abstract and functional spaces, theory of operators, spectral theory, and other topics. Covers applications of functional analysis in mathematics, mechanics, and theoretical physics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts should address topics within functional analysis or clear applications of functional-analytic methods to mathematics, mechanics, or theoretical physics. Ensure your work fits these topical areas when choosing to submit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article types accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal publishes article types such as 'Research Articles' and 'Brief Communications' (as seen in the latest issue listings).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the appropriate format: concise, focused reports for Brief Communications and full-length, original research papers for Research Articles. Follow the journal's format and length expectations for the chosen article type (refer to the journal's author guidelines on the publisher site for detailed formatting requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer-review policy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All submitted manuscripts undergo peer review; submissions should present original research of sufficient novelty and rigor to pass peer evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language of submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Welcomes manuscripts originally submitted in English.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should submit manuscripts in English as original submissions. Non-English originals or translations are not indicated as preferred; check publisher author instructions if considering submission in another language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal Impact Factor (2024)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This metric gives a yearly citation-based measure of journal influence; authors may use it when assessing journal visibility or fit, but should also consider scope and audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: 5-year Journal Impact Factor (2024)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Five-year impact factor provides a longer-term citation perspective than the 1-year impact factor; useful for evaluating sustained influence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Download metric
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download counts indicate readership and interest; higher downloads suggest broader reach or topical interest among readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstracting and indexing / discoverability
rubrics_metrics.description: Abstracted and indexed in: BFI List, Baidu, CLOCKSS, CNKI, CNPIEC, Current Contents/Physical, Chemical and Earth Sciences, Dimensions, EBSCO, Google Scholar, JST, Mathematical Reviews, Naver, OCLC WorldCat Discovery Service, Ovid Discovery, Portico, ProQuest, SCImago, SCOPUS, Science Citation Index Expanded (SCIE), TD Net Discovery Service, Wanfang, eLibrary.ru, zbMATH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal is widely indexed across major databases (including SCIE, Scopus, Math Reviews and zbMATH), which increases discoverability and citation potential. Authors seeking visibility in these indexes may find this journal appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access availability (journal-level note)
rubrics_metrics.description: This journal has 5 open access articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some articles in the journal are open access; consult the publisher's open access policy for options, fees, and which article types or issues can be published OA.
